content.short: Danketsu is a multimedia experience that integrates phygitals with blockchain technology.
content.description: Danketsu is a long-standing business in the Web 3 ecosystem that has delivered on multiple fronts, through tech solutions, multimedia expansion and cross-chain integration over the past 2.5 years.The overarching goal has always been to leverage its IP and build a sustainable business that can implement and expand blockchain integration to non-Web 3-natives.With this in mind, Danketsu has followed a stringent and thorough process of building IP with community-powered decision-making in the form of comics, toys, music, gaming, NFTs and books, since 2021.
content.meta: Find out about Danketsu (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
